{{Quote|I never saw a man who could shoot as well as he could. It was uncanny.|Jaim Helaw|<ref name="DS" />}}
'''Kan Pojo''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Pojo was an expert marksman, recognized as the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] shooting champion with several weapons. He was also the arms instructor aboard the training [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Overt (starship)|''Overt'']]. Between [[40 BBY/Legends|40]] and [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], Pojo was sent to the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] on the ''Overt'' to take back a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] controlled by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The [[Republic soldier]]s landed on the moon in its only [[City/Legends|city]], and Pojo and his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] quickly scattered the pirates throughout. Pojo chased and cornered two unarmed pirates into an alley and, confident in his abilities, offered them a chance to attack him before he could fire on them. Though Pojo shot the first pirate when they charged at him, his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] malfunctioned, and the other pirate [[Death/Legends|fatally]] stabbed him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thirty-five, forty years back, Kan Pojo was the range officer and small-arms instructor on the training ship ''Overt''.|Jaim Helaw|<ref name="DS" />}}
Kan Pojo entered the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] before [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]], and became a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. A master rifleman, Pojo was the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] champion with a variety of weapons, from [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] to [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]], and served as the small-arms teacher aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] training vessel [[Overt (starship)|''Overt'']]. At some point between 40 and [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], Pojo and the ''Overt'' were sent to the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] to deal with a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that had taken control of a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Lybeya system/Legends|system]].<ref name="DS" />

A group of about 120 pirates were stationed in the moon's domed [[City/Legends|city]]. Because of the risk of destroying the dome and exposing the moon to [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], only small weapons the size of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] could be used. Pojo, alongside naval adjunct [[Jaim Helaw]], encountered a group of about two dozens pirates, and began shooting them down with his blaster. Half of the pirates were killed in seconds, and the pirate group broke and ran.<ref name="DS" />

Pojo and Helaw followed a group of four, and after the pirates split up, the two split up also. Helaw killed the two he was chasing, and Pojo had the other two cornered. Their blasters' [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] were drained, leaving the pirates helpless. However, Pojo holstered his blaster and offered the pirates a deal. He would allow them to charge him, knowing full well that if he missed, they would kill him. The pirates attacked Pojo, but he shot one dead almost instantly.<ref name="DS" />

However, when he fired at the second, his blaster shorted out. Pojo immediately reached for his second gun, but the pirate was on him before he could draw it. The pirate stabbed Pojo with a [[Knife/Legends|knife]], killing him. Helaw shot the pirate, but Pojo was already dead. Decades later, Helaw would tell this story to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] as a way to illustrate the possible flaws in machinery, and that the more complex a machine was, the more likely its failure.<ref name="DS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Kan Pojo was the best pistoleer I ever saw&hellip;|Jaim Helaw|<ref name="DS" />}}
Jaim Helaw considered Kan Pojo the best shooter he had ever seen, and Pojo was said to have been able to pick [[Fly/Legends|flies]] off a wall from ten meters. Pojo's shooting skill was recognized by the fact that he was the Republic fleet champion with a wide variety of weapons. However, Pojo's shooting ability was rendered moot when his blaster malfunctioned, and he was killed. His arrogance in thinking that he was invincible led to this fate, as Pojo was so confident in his ability that he allowed the pirates a chance to kill him.<ref name="DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kan Pojo was created for the [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]. Pojo is only mentioned within the story, serving to illustrate a point: that the more complex technology is, the more possible flaws it possesses.
